title: Make the promotion gate judge outputs and enforce real isolation (VC-201-005)
goal: VC-201-005 refuted: judge() compares the candidate's declared expected_results against the suite — the candidate's actual output is never examined (no field exists for it), so wrong output passes; an empty candidate (did nothing) passes since empty is trivially a subset; and the write-permission boundary is a caller-supplied bool, not enforced isolation. eval_separation has no production caller. Evidence: crates/susi-gawd/src/tests/vc_201_005_mastery.rs.
